dogfood_validation_summary.headline: Phase 8 is the load-bearing dogfood-validation moment of R2a — and it succeeded under exactly the conditions dogfooding is designed to produce.
dogfood_validation_summary.thesis_tested: R2a's central thesis: per-agent design evaluation (FR-6 matrix) + ADR design-realization audit (FR-10 SA-14) move from aspiration to structural prevention. Phase 8 exercised both: authored R2a's own 37-row matrix; ran SA-14 against itself at packaging-time.
what_happened: Step 1 — R2a established the FR-6 matrix contract (Phase 5: matrix template + advisory predicate).
Step 2 — R2a established the FR-10 SA-14 audit machinery (Phase 7: audit_feature_touch_coverage.py executor + smoke 5/5 PASS + reference doc).
Step 3 — Phase 8 eat-own-dogfood phase authored R2a's own 37-row matrix (T8.1) and verified the 6 Skill-Coverage Decisions rows in synthesis.md (T8.2).

Step 4 — Cycle 0 SA-14 audit against R2a's own matrix returned FAIL. Root cause: real parser defect in T7.1's _parse_markdown_table — it stopped at first non-pipe line and missed the canonical 37-row table.
Step 5 — Cycle 1 cross-task patch fixed the defect (3-function pipeline; 2 new error rules; new smoke fixture F for multi-table regression; smoke 6/6 PASS).
Step 6 — Re-run SA-14 against T8.1 matrix: PASS, 37 rows enumerated, 0 findings.
dogfood_validation_summary.why_this_matters: This is exactly the failure mode dogfooding is designed to catch — a real defect in R2a's own machinery, exposed by running R2a's discipline against R2a's deliverables. Had SA-14 only ever been exercised against the synthetic smoke fixtures, the parser would have shipped with the single-table assumption baked in and silently false-passed on every real-world matrix authored after embedded prose. The 1-cycle reconciliation (well under the T8.1 cycle cap of 4) demonstrates the cross-task-patch dispatch matrix (Phase 5's reconciliation discipline) is sound — the handler authorized the cross-task touch into T7.1's script in service of T8.1's acceptance.
dogfood_validation_summary.discipline_consumed: 1 cycle of reconciliation on T8.1 (cycle counter 1/4). T8.2 cycle 0 (verify-only).
dogfood_validation_summary.open_residual: I-PQ-P8-001 MINOR — SA-14 reference doc lag (2 new rule constants undocumented; 'first table' narrative stale). Non-blocking; deferred.

cross_task_consistency_decision.issue: None — T8.1 (matrix authoring + cross-task patch + SA-14 re-run PASS) and T8.2 (synthesis Skill-Coverage Decisions verification) are independent acceptance tracks that converge on the Phase 8 dogfood thesis. The cross-task patch from T8.1 cycle 1 into T7.1's audit script was authorized by the Phase 5 dispatch matrix and explicitly accepted by the handler as in-service-of-T8.1's-acceptance (T7.1's deliverable contract was 'SA-14 executor passes its smoke tests', which it did; the parser defect was a robustness gap that only manifested under T8.1's real-world matrix input — exactly the dogfood signal).
cross_task_consistency_decision.outcome: Phase 8 PASS. No additional reconciliation dispatched. The 1-cycle reconciliation already consumed during T8.1 was productive.
